projects.name: Next-Word Prediction App
projects.summary: MLP-based next-word prediction model with a Streamlit app.
highlights: Trained on Indian Food Recipes dataset.
Generates recipe-based text sequences.
Interactive Streamlit app with configurable hyperparameters.

projects.name: Matrix Factorization-Based Image Reconstruction & Compression
highlights: Implemented matrix factorization for image reconstruction.
Designed image compression pipeline using low-rank matrix factorization and gradient descent.
Achieved high compression ratios while preserving image quality.

projects.name: Human Activity Recognition (HAR)
projects.summary: Decision Tree model for activity recognition using time-series data.
highlights: Analyzed the UCI-HAR dataset, featuring time-series data of 30 subjects performing six activities.
Utilized the TSFEL library for feature extraction and PCA for dimensionality reduction.
Trained a Decision Tree model on the featurized data and tested it using the activity data collected with the Physics Toolbox Suite app to achieve 66% accuracy and 67% precision.
Built a custom Decision Tree implementation from scratch, achieving results comparable to Scikit-learn, with tree visualization via Graphviz.

projects.name: EdgeNet - Image Filters with CNNs
projects.summary: Designed U-Net-based CNN to approximate classical edge-detection techniques.
highlights: Approximated Sobel, Laplacian, and Prewitt filters without explicit filter kernels.
Achieved 93.47% accuracy and SSIM of 0.92.

projects.name: Blithchron Website and PWA
projects.summary: Developed the official Blithchron '25 website using Astro and React.js.
highlights: Integrated Astro for static site generation and React.js for dynamic content.
Built a Progressive Web App (PWA) for mobile users.

projects.name: DragNotes
highlights: Added drag-and-drop functionality.
Integrated Appwrite for backend services and real-time syncing.
Implemented auto-save and customizable note colors for personalized user experience.
